title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $\sigma$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $\sigma$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. translated_title: 从众数到记忆：刻画扩散模型的尺度空间动力学
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通常被视为将噪声转化为数据的随机过程。我们采取一种互补的视角：扩散模型定义了一族由噪声尺度索引的确定性动力系统。在每个固定尺度 σ 下，我们将去噪器视为一个自映射并研究其动力学。对于精确去噪器，不动点对应于平滑后数据密度的临界点，而吸引子对应于其众数；随着 σ 增大，样本级别的众数逐渐合并为越来越粗糙的众数。这暗示了一种对记忆化现象的几何视角：由于重复或过拟合而获得过多概率质量的样本，以及离群点，应当在比普通样本更强的平滑下仍然保持可区分。我们用临界尺度 σ_c 来量化这种持久性，即固定尺度动力学仍能保留某个样本的最大噪声尺度。在条件模型中，同样的构建（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文将扩散模型重新诠释为由噪声尺度索引的确定性动力系统族，揭示不动点与吸引子分别对应平滑数据密度的临界点与众数，并提出用临界尺度 σ_c 从几何角度量化训练样本的记忆化与离群程度。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts diffusion models as a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale, showing that fixed points and attractors correspond to critical points and modes of the smoothed data density, and quantifies memorization geometrically via a critical scale σ_c at which examples remain distinguishable.
